#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    string s;
    cin >> s;
    int ans1 = 0, ans2 = 0;
    int i = 0;
    while (i < n) {
        switch (s[i]) {
            case '(':
                {
                    int len = 0;
                    while (i + 1 < n) {
                        char next = s[i + 1];
                        if (next == ')') {
                            if (len > 0) ans2++;
                            break;
                        }
                        if (next == '_') {
                            if (len > 0) { ans2++; len = 0; }
                        } else {
                            len++;
                        }
                        i++;
                    }
                }
                break;
            case ')':
            case '_':
                {
                    int len2 = 0;
                    while (i + 1 < n && s[i + 1] != ')' && s[i + 1] != '_' && s[i + 1] != '(') {
                        len2++;
                        i++;
                    }
                    ans1 = max(ans1, len2);
                }
                break;
            default:
                {
                    int len3 = 0;
                    while (i < n && s[i] != ')' && s[i] != '_' && s[i] != '(') {
                        len3++;
                        i++;
                    }
                    ans1 = max(ans1, len3);
                    i--;
                }
                break;
        }
        i++;
    }
    cout << ans1 << " " << ans2 << endl;
    return 0;
}
